rules.requirement: If the Demon kills you, you learn that it is 1 of 2 players.

assertingTests.name: a player who did not die as the Sage gets no death information (SNV-SAGE-01)
the Sage's death-triggered wake keeps its official slot (SNV-SAGE-01)
a host answer to the Dreamer and the Sage changes no game state and stays private (SNV-DREAMER-01, SNV-SAGE-01)
a sober Sage offers only pairs with the Demon that killed them (SNV-SAGE-01)
an impaired Sage may show the Demon, and a Vortox forbids it (SNV-SAGE-01)
the Sage shows the Demon who killed them after the Barber moves the Demon character (SNV-SAGE-01)
a saved 0.4.1 journal replays its sober Dreamer and Sage answers without a pair (SNV-DREAMER-01, SNV-SAGE-01)
